HIGH.finding: Anchor population fails the 60-percent screen on 30/30 census decision dates (measured populated share of eligible names 0.296-0.367; at its own scored dates 101-149 populated names, 6-9 of 11 sectors with >= 6 ranked names, minimum sector population 1). The sector-neutral tercile construction degenerates to 2-name legs in thin sectors. Real risk of post-scoring pressure to relax the declared 330-400d eff-date filter - a forced parameter change the freeze statement forbids; adjudicate at selection freeze.

Causal negative control (CommonStockSharesAuthorized 12m change) is degenerate: 80.8% of eligible name-dates show exactly zero change, 15.4% unpopulated, only 3.7% nonzero. Placebo ranks are tie-dominated, the placebo book is tie-break-determined, and the preregistered falsification rule (placebo reproduces anchor) can essentially never fire - the control gate passes vacuously and identifies nothing (L7).

Declared 'near-orthogonal' placebo (AOCI 12m change) measured Spearman 0.80-0.94 against the anchor ranks over all 30 census dates. The causal control is NOT rank-distinct as declared; the |placebo alpha| < 0.5x anchor gate risks false-killing the family or passing while measuring the same exposure. Control identifiability fails the declared ex-ante profile by measurement (L7).

MEDIUM.finding: Benchmark data not staged in this worktree: .staging_prices_v8/eod holds only the 409 filer files and p0a_eodhd_price_manifest.json contains no SPY or sector-ETF entries, but every proposal's Stage-A gates require the risk-matched SPY context (P3 factor_and_benchmark) and a4_h1/a4_h2 gates require the mapped SPDR sector-ETF factor. The V4 benchmark contract (research/control/stocks_free_v4_run/p2_a3_benchmark_contract.json) staged SPY+11 ETFs in the V4 cycle; V8 must re-stage them via the authorized EODHD path BEFORE scoring. Resolvable; unresolved at audit time.

The 21-session decision grid is labeled 'one quarter' but is approximately one trading month (measured cadence 9.05-10.7 decisions/yr; 63 sessions is a quarter). Session-index parameters are frozen so scoring is unaffected, but holding-period and turnover prose ('effective holding 1-2 quarters', 'below the 6.0 ceiling') should be read at monthly cadence; the label should be corrected at freeze, not after scoring.

Declared control correlation profile 'near zero or negative' measured at Spearman 0.23-0.35 (mean 0.295) over all 30 census dates. Ranks remain distinct and the gate stays meaningful, but the ex-ante profile is measurably wrong; the control-interpretation margin is narrower than declared.

The 30-decision total sits exactly at the min_decisions_total floor with zero slack: any decision date dropped at scoring (e.g., degenerate book, all-CASH abstention) falls below the P3 floor. The a5 pair has no buffer decisions.

LOW.finding: Declared scored counts (approx 22/26/27, approx 75 total) mismatch measured 22/22/22 = 66; a6 pair declared approx 86 (28/29/29) vs measured 78 (26/26/26). All floors still met; estimates conflated unscored grid counts with scored counts.
One census date (2025-05-23) at 0.598 populated share, 0.2pp under the 60% screen; 29/30 pass.

Declared 150-250 LOC is 2-3x below the a5 pair's estimate (450-650) for comparable machinery (as-of stacks, PIT gate, sector-neutral books, band costs, controls, reruns); LOC is not a capped resource, no feasibility impact.
OLV-neighbour outcome path is 'downweighted/flagged for adjudication' rather than falsification - softer than the range-width control's clean kill; noted for adjudication consistency.

audit_method_notes.no_pnl: All measurements are counts, populations, rank correlations, and cost arithmetic. No returns, PnL, or expectancy of any arm was computed or estimated; break-even numbers are cost-arithmetic minimums, not performance forecasts.
audit_method_notes.fail_closed_notes: none required - every requested quantity was measurable from the staged inputs
